entry_rationale: Independent concentrated fade of the 99.6 five-year extreme. Short AUDNZD isolates kiwi cheapness versus Australia rather than fighting a firm dollar. Size for a few percent of adverse extension without filling the shock budget. The booked Canada receive lesson stays on that name and does not apply here.
entry_thesis: AUDNZD at 1.2456 is a five-year extreme while NZDUSD still sits in the cheap tail at 0.5627. That cross has stretched far beyond a 30-basis-point Australia versus New Zealand 10-year gap, and it is the only concentrated, asymmetric swing on a firm tape. Short the cross as a real swing; oil remaining bid is the accepted tax, not a reason to stay flat. CORRA March stays closed: 2.55 cash versus 2.925 is the same leftover path already booked into the event-implied print, not a new dislocation versus cash or the Bank of Canada.
